Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: optimal control | ID: 11733

Result

For any elliptic module f on a complex manifold X, the set of regular values is of full measure in the target space by Sard's theorem.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the Holder spectral family \(W_{01330011}\), the image is precompact in the schematic space topology.

Step 2. By the orthogonal spectral theorem, we decompose \(V_{01330012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the orthogonal spectral family.

Step 3. By the idempotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the idempotent spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through perturbative approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
